caption:
The 'bedroom' is melting into grey sludge. A pretty dramatic way for the simulation to crash. I ignored the dizziness and just shoved against the heavy door until it gave way with a metallic clack. I finally have my hands on the cartridge—heavy, cold, and definitely real. Then the lights snapped to a rhythmic red strobe and the alarm started its frantic drone.

Eve stands in the strobing alcove as the heavy blast doors begin to cycle shut, trapping her inside.

#neotokyo #glitch #archive #lockdown #cyberpunk #hardware
